name: studium-vscode
description: Run a Studium adaptive lesson in VS Code: a tutoring loop driven over the lesson-mcp server, with an artifact pane that renders each scene's figures, equations, interactive plots, and executed reference runs — pair by pair.

studium.repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the prototype-build monorepo (defaults to the extension's own monorepo root).

studium.bundlesRoot.description: Directory the lesson-mcp server resolves bundle_ref against (BUNDLES_ROOT).

studium.bundleRef.description: The bundle to open (relative to bundlesRoot). 11-enriched.json carries live artifacts (equation, plot, executed run).

studium.assets.description: Where the webview loads KaTeX/Vega from: 'vendor' (offline, bundled in media/vendor — air-gap safe) or 'cdn' (jsdelivr).

studium.telemetryConsent.description: Opt in to consented, pseudonymized class telemetry (STUDIUM_TELEMETRY_CONSENT).

studium.showGraph.description: Open a companion live Learning-Workflow-Graph panel that repaints each turn (typed-graph-lens).

studium.graphView.description: Graph scope: 'student' (ego-graph around the current frontier) or 'teacher' (the whole graph).

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p media/vendor/katex && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.js node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css media/vendor/katex/ && cp -R node_modules/katex/dist/fonts media/vendor/katex/fonts && cp node_modules/vega/build/vega.min.js node_modules/vega-lite/build/vega-lite.min.js node_modules/vega-embed/build/vega-embed.min.js media/vendor/ && cp node_modules/cytoscape/dist/cytoscape.min.js node_modules/dagre/dist/dagre.min.js node_modules/cytoscape-dagre/dist/cytoscape-dagre.js node_modules/3dmol/build/3Dmol-min.js media/vendor/
